scientific_integrity: The proof uses exact stationary coboundary identities and an invariant-level argument; finite computation is used only to check source-parameter substitutions and implementation of the algebraic identities.
scientific_limitations: The support-crossing theorem is unconditional for compact non-equilibrium ergodic invariant measures. The RMS ceiling additionally assumes support in \(y\ge0\). The result does not establish existence, uniqueness, or chaos of any invariant set.
title: Exact stationary threshold-crossing laws for the SL8II and SL8III controlled flows
